items.q: But she was jealous of me because I had ideas about singing jazz and she didn't. The result was that after singing in the club for 4 nights, I was told that I was not needed after that.

ctx.x: Grappelli told me that Django and Joseph were gypsies. Django had had an accident with his left hand when he was younger and could only use three fingers. But he used those three fingers as if they were ten.

There was a woman from the USA who had been in France quite a long time, who was also singing at l'Heure Bleue. Her name was Ida Smith, but she was known as Bricktop, because she had red hair and she was a light skin negro woman. She was quite popular in the night club circle of Paris. But she was jealous of me because I had ideas about singing jazz and she didn't. The result was that after singing in the club for 4 nights, I was told that I was not needed after that. Paris in 1935 was much more lively than it is today. There seemed to be a certain sort of happiness among the people which you do not see today. No one seemed to concentrate on money. Everybody could go to a bar, and if they couldn't pay, they had their credit. The economy didn't interfere with anybody's way of life. Life was cheaper and it was much gayer.
